title: Cairn
oneLiner: A job application tracker with no streaks, no cohort comparisons and no confetti anywhere in it.
description: Job hunting is already stressful. Cairn keeps track of where you've applied, what comes next, and what still needs attention, without turning the process into a game.

title: hued
oneLiner: Turns your camera roll into the colours you actually lived in, with no network permission.
description: Your camera roll is a diary in colour. hued turns a month of photos into a palette that reveals the moods, places, and moments that defined it.

title: Momentum
oneLiner: Breaks a long goal into a number for today, recomputed in a pure-Kotlin engine layer.
description: Turn a long-term goal into today's task. Momentum calculates the pace you need, adapts when you miss days, and keeps progress realistic instead of perfect.

title: TimeShift
oneLiner: Right-click any time on a page and read it in your own zone, CST and IST disambiguated.
description: Convert times across time zones directly from any webpage. Highlight a time, right-click, and instantly see it in your local zone.

title: Design System
oneLiner: Accessible React primitives with semantic tokens: {{ds.componentCount}} components, and this page is built on them.
description: A React component library that makes it easy to build consistent interfaces. {{ds.componentCount}} accessible components across {{ds.categoryCount}} categories with built-in theming.
